entries.title: Spinning Funnel Cloud over a Town Grid
entries.description: A transparent rotating funnel-shaped tornado descends from a swirling cloud base above a flat town grid of box houses, pulling in small debris particles that spiral upward with trails while buildings can detach roofs, slide, and collide as the funnel path curves across the scene.
entries.seed: Spinning Funnel Cloud over a Town Grid: A transparent rotating funnel-shaped tornado descends from a swirling cloud base above a flat town grid of box houses, pulling in small debris particles that spiral upward with trails while buildings can detach roofs, slide, and collide as the funnel path curves across the scene.

entries.title: Multiple Tornado Outbreak over Farmland
entries.description: Several semi-transparent cone and wedge tornadoes spawn from a moving storm line above a checkered field of crops and silos, with each tornado leaving a darker ground “scar” strip, uprooting scattered cylinders (trees) and transferring them into rotating debris rings that orbit the core before falling out.

entries.title: Tornado Formation from Rotating Thunderstorm Updraft
entries.description: A rotating cylindrical updraft cloud spins above a flat plane, where inflowing air particles (small spheres with trails) spiral inward, condense into a tightening vertical column, and gradually stretch downward to form a funnel that touches the ground and intensifies as more particles attach.

entries.title: Dust Devil Swarm over a Desert Plain
entries.description: Dozens of small, semi-transparent dust devils randomly spawn and dissipate over a light-colored sand plane, with dust particles that bounce, wrap around the mini-vortices, and leave faint spiral trails while a moving sun light source shifts their shading and shadow direction.

entries.title: Tornado Crossing a River and Splitting Spray
entries.description: A single fast-moving tornado cone translates across a landscape and passes over a blue river strip, sucking water upward as translucent spray particles that spiral and mix with darker debris, briefly widening the funnel and changing its color gradient before it continues onto land.

entries.title: Twin Tornado Interaction and Merger
entries.description: Two adjacent rotating funnels move toward each other over a plain, their debris rings and inflow particle streams intersect and collide, and the weaker tornado gradually transfers its particles and rotation into the stronger one, visualized as color-coded swirling streams that merge into a single larger vortex.

entries.title: Tornado Impact on Wind Turbines
entries.description: A wind farm of tall rotating turbines stands on a plane while a tornado approaches; turbine blades spin, bend, or detach as the vortex passes, with individual blade fragments becoming debris that orbit the funnel, collide with other turbines, and leave tumbling motion trails.

entries.title: Microscopic Tornado Vortex in a Fluid Tank
entries.description: Inside a transparent cylindrical tank filled with colored fluid particles, a rotating stirrer rod at the top creates a miniature “water tornado” vortex, pulling particles downward into a tight spiral column where densities mix, colors blend, and small tracer particles glow as they cycle through the vortex core.

entries.title: Tornado Alley Map with Moving Storm Cells
entries.description: A large flat map with labeled towns and highways shows box-shaped storm cells moving and rotating overhead, occasionally spawning semi-transparent tornado funnels that track along labeled paths, leaving thin ground tracks, while a side meter shows tornado intensity changing color as wind speed particles accelerate.

entries.title: Tornado Interacting with a Moving Train
entries.description: A long train of connected box cars moves along a straight track as a tornado crosses the line; individual cars can detach when hit, lift slightly, and rotate into the vortex, with couplers snapping, wheels bouncing and scattering, and a cloud of small metallic debris orbiting the funnel.

entries.title: City Skyscraper Canyon Tornado
entries.description: A tornado weaves through tall rectangular skyscrapers, with wind vectors represented by arrows wrapping around building edges, loose panels detaching and spiraling into the core, glass particles scattering and reflecting light, and the funnel shape stretching and bending as it squeezes between structures.

entries.title: Tornado-Driven Power Grid Failure
entries.description: A grid of poles and power lines stands on a light background terrain while a tornado approaches; poles can snap, wires detach and whip around, briefly arcing with glowing sparks where they collide or touch the ground, and a color-coded network diagram in one corner dims as nodes lose power.

entries.title: Waterspout over the Ocean Surface
entries.description: A tall, slender vortex connects a rotating cloud base to a rippling blue water surface, drawing water droplets upward into a twisting transparent column; ocean spray particles bounce and mix at the base while a moving boat is tugged sideways by the inflow, leaving a curved wake trail.
